```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(here)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

schools     <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
visits      <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "visits.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
surveys     <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "surveys.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
issues      <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "issues.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
new_projects <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "new_projects.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
full_updates <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "full_updates.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Parse survey dates
surveys <- surveys |> mutate(
  survey_date = parse_date_time(StartDate, orders = c("mdY HMS", "Ymd HMS", "mdY HM")),
  survey_date = as.Date(survey_date)
)

# Build JSON for JS-side filtering
visits_json <- visits |>
  mutate(
    slug = school_name |> str_to_lower() |> str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |> str_remove("-$"),
    visit_date = as.character(visit_date)
  ) |>
  select(school_name, slug, visitor, visit_reason, activities, urgent_issues, visit_date) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

issues_json <- issues |>
  mutate(visit_date = as.character(visit_date)) |>
  select(school_name, urgent_issues, visit_date, visitor) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

projects_json <- new_projects |>
  mutate(project_date = as.character(project_date)) |>
  select(school_name, visitor, project_type, project_date) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

full_json <- full_updates |>
  mutate(update_date = as.character(update_date)) |>
  select(school_name, update_date) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

surveys_json <- surveys |>
  mutate(survey_date = as.character(survey_date)) |>
  select(school_name, survey_date) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

schools_json <- schools |>
  select(school_name, Region, `EPI Start Year`, Latitude, Longitude,
         MGR, `Non-Generating MGR`, `Feminine Hygiene Kits`, `Science Kits`,
         Library, Computer, `Construction Projects`, Boreholes,
         `Solar Power`, `Biofill Toilets`, `Light a Village`,
         n_visits, n_responses, n_issues) |>
  toJSON(auto_unbox = TRUE)

# Date range for selector defaults
all_dates <- c(visits$visit_date, new_projects$project_date, full_updates$update_date, surveys$survey_date)
all_dates <- all_dates[!is.na(all_dates)]
date_min <- as.character(min(all_dates))
date_max <- as.character(max(all_dates))
```

## School Map

```{r}
#| echo: false
schools_with_coords <- schools |>
  filter(!is.na(Latitude) & !is.na(Longitude))

leaflet(schools_with_coords) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~Longitude, lat = ~Latitude,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", school_name, "</strong><br>",
      "Region: ", Region, "<br>",
      "EPI Start: ", `EPI Start Year`, "<br>",
      "Visits: ", n_visits, " | Surveys: ", n_responses
    ),
    radius = 6,
    color = "#1C2B4A",
    fillColor = "#F5B800",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 2
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
  '<script>\nconst ALL_VISITS = ', visits_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_ISSUES = ', issues_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_PROJECTS = ', projects_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_FULL = ', full_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_SURVEYS = ', surveys_json,
  ';\nconst ALL_SCHOOLS = ', schools_json,
  ';\n</script>'
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat(r"--(
<script>
// Helper: filter array by date range
function inRange(dateStr, start, end) {
  if (!dateStr) return false;
  var d = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
  return d >= start && d <= end;
}

// DataTable instances
var projectsTable = null;

// cell style
var cs = 'padding:0.75rem; border-bottom:1px solid #e9ecef;';

// Main render function
function renderDashboard() {
  var start = document.getElementById('date-start').value;
  var end   = document.getElementById('date-end').value;

  // Filter data
  var visits   = ALL_VISITS.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.visit_date, start, end); });
  var issues   = ALL_ISSUES.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.visit_date, start, end); });
  var projects = ALL_PROJECTS.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.project_date, start, end); });
  var full     = ALL_FULL.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.update_date, start, end); });
  var surveys  = ALL_SURVEYS.filter(function(v) { return inRange(v.survey_date, start, end); });

  // Stat cards
  document.getElementById('stat-visits').textContent   = visits.length;
  document.getElementById('stat-projects').textContent  = projects.length;
  document.getElementById('stat-full').textContent      = full.length;
  document.getElementById('stat-surveys').textContent   = surveys.length;
  document.getElementById('stat-issues').textContent    = issues.length;

  // Recent Projects table
  var sortedProjects = projects.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    return (b.project_date || '').localeCompare(a.project_date || '');
  });
  var projectsBody = document.getElementById('recent-projects-body');
  projectsBody.innerHTML = '';
  sortedProjects.forEach(function(p) {
    var tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.innerHTML =
      '<td style="' + cs + '">' + (p.project_date || '') + '</td>' +
      '<td style="' + cs + '">' + (p.school_name || '') + '</td>' +
      '<td style="' + cs + '">' + (p.visitor || '') + '</td>' +
      '<td style="' + cs + '">' + (p.project_type || '') + '</td>';
    projectsBody.appendChild(tr);
  });

  if (projectsTable) { projectsTable.destroy(); projectsTable = null; }
  if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined' && jQuery.fn.DataTable) {
    projectsTable = jQuery('#recent-projects-table').DataTable({
      pageLength: 10,
      order: [[0, 'desc']],
      language: { search: 'Filter:' }
    });
  }

  // Program Reach bars
  var programCols = [
    { key: 'MGR', label: 'MGR (Merry-Go-Round)' },
    { key: 'Non-Generating MGR', label: 'Non-Generating MGR' },
    { key: 'Feminine Hygiene Kits', label: 'Feminine Hygiene Kits' },
    { key: 'Science Kits', label: 'Science Kits' },
    { key: 'Library', label: 'Library' },
    { key: 'Computer', label: 'Computer Lab' },
    { key: 'Construction Projects', label: 'Construction Projects' },
    { key: 'Boreholes', label: 'Boreholes' },
    { key: 'Solar Power', label: 'Solar Power' },
    { key: 'Biofill Toilets', label: 'Biofill Toilets' },
    { key: 'Light a Village', label: 'Light a Village' }
  ];

  var barsHtml = '';
  programCols.forEach(function(prog) {
    var total = ALL_SCHOOLS.length;
    var withProg = ALL_SCHOOLS.filter(function(s) { return Number(s[prog.key]) >= 1; }).length;
    var pct = Math.round((withProg / total) * 100);
    var barWidth = Math.max(pct, 3);
    barsHtml +=
      '<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; margin-bottom:0.4rem;">' +
      '<span style="width:180px; font-size:0.85rem;">' + prog.label + '</span>' +
      '<div class="program-bar" style="flex:1;">' +
      '<div class="fill" style="width:' + barWidth + '%;">' + pct + '%</div>' +
      '</div></div>';
  });
  document.getElementById('program-bars').innerHTML = barsHtml;

  // Schools with Open Issues
  var schoolsWithIssues = [];
  var seen = {};
  issues.forEach(function(i) {
    if (!seen[i.school_name]) {
      seen[i.school_name] = true;
      schoolsWithIssues.push(i.school_name);
    }
  });
  var totalSchools = ALL_SCHOOLS.length;
  var pctWithIssues = totalSchools > 0 ? Math.round((schoolsWithIssues.length / totalSchools) * 100) : 0;

  var issuesHtml = '';
  issuesHtml +=
    '<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:1.5rem;">' +
    '<span style="font-size:2rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--epi-navy);">' + schoolsWithIssues.length + '</span>' +
    '<span style="font-size:0.9rem; color:#666;"> / ' + totalSchools + ' schools</span>' +
    '<div style="font-size:0.85rem; color:#999;">(' + pctWithIssues + '% of schools have open issues)</div>' +
    '</div>';

  if (schoolsWithIssues.length > 0) {
    schoolsWithIssues.sort();
    schoolsWithIssues.forEach(function(name) {
      var schoolIssues = issues.filter(function(i) { return i.school_name === name; });
      var slug = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/-$/, '');
      issuesHtml +=
        '<div style="border-left:3px solid #dc3545; padding-left:0.75rem; margin-bottom:0.75rem;">' +
        '<a href="schools.html?school=' + slug + '" style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-weight:600; font-size:0.9rem; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--epi-navy);">' + name + '</a>' +
        '<span style="color:#999; font-size:0.8rem;"> (' + schoolIssues.length + ' issue' + (schoolIssues.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + ')</span>';
      schoolIssues.forEach(function(iss) {
        issuesHtml += '<div style="font-size:0.8rem; color:#555; margin-top:0.2rem;">' + iss.urgent_issues + '</div>';
      });
      issuesHtml += '</div>';
    });
  } else {
    issuesHtml += '<p style="color:#999; font-style:italic;">No urgent issues flagged in this date range.</p>';
  }
  document.getElementById('issues-summary').innerHTML = issuesHtml;
}

// Use window.onload to ensure all CDN scripts are loaded
window.addEventListener('load', function() {
  renderDashboard();

  document.getElementById('btn-apply-dates').addEventListener('click', renderDashboard);

  document.getElementById('btn-reset-dates').addEventListener('click', function() {
    var allDates = []
      .concat(ALL_VISITS.map(function(v) { return v.visit_date; }))
      .concat(ALL_PROJECTS.map(function(v) { return v.project_date; }))
      .concat(ALL_FULL.map(function(v) { return v.update_date; }))
      .concat(ALL_SURVEYS.map(function(v) { return v.survey_date; }))
      .filter(function(d) { return d; });
    allDates.sort();
    document.getElementById('date-start').value = allDates[0] || '';
    document.getElementById('date-end').value = allDates[allDates.length - 1] || '';
    renderDashboard();
  });
});
</script>
)--")
```
